blurb: DETOURS American West offers guided van, SUV, and air tours departing from Phoenix/Scottsdale and Sedona/Flagstaff. Tours include visits to destinations like the Grand Canyon, Sedona, Tombstone, and Verde Valley wineries. Guests travel in comfortable vehicles with experienced guides who share knowledge about the region.
